{{Quote|Sir, Rebel ships are coming into our sector.''"<br />"''Good. Our first catch of the day.|Lieutenant Cabbel and Captain Xamuel Lennox, during the Battle of Hoth|audio=Cabbel-Lennox.flac|<ref name="ESB" />}}
'''Cabbel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He attended the [[Officer's Candidate School]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] and was a recent graduate by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Cabbel was stationed aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']], under the command of Captain [[Xamuel Lennox]], prior to the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]], which culminated in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] defeat by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]].

By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Cabbel had become a Navy Lieutenant and was stationed on the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], attached to the Imperial [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], where he aided [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]] in deploying [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in search of the Alliance's hidden headquarters. The search led to the discovery of a [[Echo Base/Legends|hidden Rebel base]] on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], leading to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. By then, Cabbel served as the [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]] of the ''Tyrant'', which was still under Lennox's command. Cabbel and Lennox both participated in the Hoth battle, during which the ''Tyrant'' was disabled by an Alliance [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|ion cannon]] fired from the planet.

==Biography==
===Early Imperial career===
{{Quote|Captain Needa!''"<br />"''Yes, Lieutenant?''"<br />"''Sir, Imperial Headquarters reports that a Rebel convoy has been completely destroyed near Derra IV.|Lieutenant Cabbel and Captain Lorth Needa discuss the Battle of Derra IV|<ref name="ESB RD">{{ESBRadio|Freedom's Winter}}</ref>}}
[[File:Star_Wars_X-wing_Cabbel_and_Xamuel_Lennox.png|thumb|left|250px|Cabbel and Lennox on the ''Tyrant'' prior to the Battle of Turkana]]
Cabbel, a [[Human/Legends|Human]], lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ESB" /> A student of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer's Candidate School]] on<ref name="CCG-Cabbel" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Carida">{{CSWECite|I|109|Carida}}</ref> [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], he was a recent graduate<ref name="CCG-Cabbel" /> by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Turkana date">The ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' had [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Xamuel Lennox]] commanding the [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']] during the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]]. As the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] made use of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] during the battle, it must occur after the Rebels' [[Fresian campaign|campaign]] to obtain the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], which occurred in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] according to ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. In [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], the Battle of Turkana occurred at the start of the game, with the end of the second tour of duty focusing on the Alliance obtaining the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]]. Those missions occurred shortly after the [[Battle of Kattada]], which took place in 35:2 GrS&mdash;or 1 BBY&mdash;by its concurrence with the [[Subjugation of Ralltiir]] and that battle's dating in ''[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]''. From this information, it can be determined that the Battle of Turkana occurred in 1 BBY. Because Cabbel is depicted as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] in that game, and {{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Cabbel}} mentioned he was a graduate from the [[Officer's Candidate School]], then he had to have graduated 1 BBY at the latest.</ref> Cabbel was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command bridge]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Xamuel Lennox]]'s [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']],<ref name="X-Wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref> which was stationed in the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]] and led ten [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the planet [[Turkana/Legends|Turkana]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> Cabbel informed Lennox that [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] had located an Alliance fleet [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Turkana, prompting Lennox's response to order the Imperial attack on the Alliance fleet, moving the Star Destroyers within range and launching all [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]].<ref name="X-Wing" /> The ''Tyrant'' led the attack in the subsequent [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]], where the Alliance [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] ended up defeating the Imperial fleet, and Lennox ordered a retreat into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and regrouping at [[Pakuuni/Legends|Pakuuni]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], concurrent to the [[Battle of Derra IV]] mentioned in the film's [[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|radio dramatization]], to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> Cabbel attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="CCG-Cabbel" /> That year,<ref name="NEC" /> he served aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]]<ref name="ESB RD" /><ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=Reporting to Needa|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/112358/cid/7720144/2015-Topps-Star-Wars-Illustrated-The-Empire-Strikes-Back-3-Reporting-to-Needa}}</ref> and attached to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] Imperial [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]]. In the same year, the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] of Death Squadron deployed [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in an attempt to find the Rebel Alliance's hidden location.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The ''Avenger'' was part of the search, and, following the [[Battle of Derra IV]], Cabbel passed on to Needa Imperial headquarters' report of a Rebel Alliance convoy being completely destroyed near the [[Derra IV/Legends|planet]]. He then reported to Needa that the first set of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] detected no Rebel or even Human activity on the planets they reconnoitered, and that the second set of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] was ready to be deployed. However, Needa requested to delay the order to launch the droids, as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader had requested the probe droids to be reprogrammed to include information on both Rebel [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], to which Cabbel complied,<ref name="ESB RD" /><ref name="Topps" /> along with Vader's orders to revise the probe droids' targeting list for the planets [[Allyuen/Legends|Allyuen]], [[Tokmia/Legends|Tokmia]] and [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="ESB RD script">[[The Empire Strikes Back: The National Public Radio Dramatization|''The Empire Strikes Back'': The National Public Radio Dramatization]]</ref>

===Battle of Hoth===
{{Quote|All stations report!|Lieutenant Cabbel, after the ''Tyrant'' was hit by an ion cannon during the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-11-serving-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 11: Serving the Empire}}</ref>}}
[[File:Lennox_Cabbel.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Cabbel and Lennox on the ''Tyrant'' at the Battle of Hoth]]
While Death Squadron was near the [[Qeimet system/Legends|Qeimet system]],<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> one of the probe droids discovered evidence of the Rebels' [[Echo Base/Legends|base]] on Hoth.<ref name="ESB" /> Death Squadron then made a series of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps to reach the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]],<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> culminating in the subsequent [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. While Vader's [[Blizzard Force/Legends|forces]] launched a ground assault on the planet, the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] of Death Squadron attempted to intercept escaping<ref name="ESB" /> Rebel [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> leaving Hoth.<ref name="ESB" /> Cabbel had by then returned to the ''Tyrant'', which was also attached to Death Squadron,<ref name="CCG-Tyrant">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=''Tyrant''}}</ref> serving as the [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]]<ref name="CCG-Cabbel" /> to Captain Lennox.<ref name="CCG-Lennox">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Captain Lennox}}</ref> Aboard the ''Tyrant''{{'s}} command bridge, Cabbel informed Lennox when the first of the [[Transport/Legends|transports]],<ref name="ESB" /> the [[Quantum Storm/Legends|''Quantum Storm'']],<ref name="CSWE-QS">{{CSWECite|III|59|''Quantum Storm''}}</ref> escorted by two T-65 X-wing starfighters, approached the Star Destroyer's position. However, as the ''Tyrant'' prepared to intercept the transport, the Rebel base fired its planetary [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|ion cannon]] at the Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warship]],<ref name="ESB" /> causing its [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] to overload, which made the Star Destroyer lose its helm.<ref name="ESB RD" />

[[File:TyrantDisabled-BTCTG.png|thumb|left|250px|The disabled ''Tyrant'' above Hoth]]
As power was lost throughout the ''Tyrant'', Cabbel barked orders that none of the crew were listening to, eventually demanding for all stations to report, which Lennox requested to be belayed. Soon, the command bridge's backup generator failed, disabling the ''Tyrant''{{'s}} [[Artificial gravity generator/Legends|artificial gravity system]], causing Cabbel to fall over in consternation and various objects to float in midair. The entire ship was silent with the exception of Cabbel sputtering and the crew giving useless status reports as Lennox realized the ''Tyrant'' would be dead in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] until the Battle of Hoth's outcome was decided.<ref name="Warfare Author's Cut" />

While the ''Tyrant'' was undergoing repairs, Imperial forces captured Rebel [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] and transferred their [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] aboard the Star Destroyer. However, the ''Tyrant'' was hit once more from a blast fired by the [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]], and Madine was rescued, with the ship unable to give pursuit due to the amount of ion damage it had received.<ref name="TPOVDSC">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign|parent=1}}</ref> Although the disabled ''Tyrant'' was left floating through the Hoth system, and more Rebel transports made it off the planet, the Battle of Hoth still ended as a resounding Imperial victory, with the Rebels forced to retreat from their [[Alliance High Command/Legends|headquarters]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Sir, the Rebels' last base was on a tropical planet. Their equipment and supplies are mostly suited for jungle conditions.''"<br />"''Are you questioning a directive from Lord Vader, Lieutenant?''"<br />"''No, sir, of course not!|Lieutenant Cabbel and Captain Lorth Needa discuss the orders for their second set of probe droids to target Hoth|<ref name="ESB RD script" />}}
Cabbel was efficient, as well as ambitious and ruthless,<ref name="CCG-Cabbel" /> and was described by his men in the same way.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|103|Cabbel, Lieutenant}}</ref> While aboard the ''Avenger'', Cabbel questioned Captain Needa relaying Darth Vader's orders to include the [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet Hoth in the probe droids' targeting list, considering the Alliance's [[Unidentified Rebel base (Derra IV)|last base]] was on a [[Derra IV/Legends|tropical planet]]. Nonetheless, he decided not to further question a directive from the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], and complied with Needa's request to retarget the droids for Allyuen, Tokmia, and Hoth, albeit still showing hesitance with the ice planet.<ref name="ESB RD script" /> After the ion cannon's first strike on the ''Tyrant'' during the Battle of Hoth, Cabbel barked orders in the confusion, despite nobody else listening to him. When the ship's artificial gravity system was lost, Cabbel's sputtering, along with the crew's status reports, were the only sounds heard on the ''Tyrant''.<ref name="Warfare Author's Cut" /> He had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and fair skin.<ref name="ESB" />

==Skills and abilities==
Cabbel was an extremely intelligent individual. He also had slightly above average speed, fighting ability, diplomacy skills, and above average strength. The lieutenant was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].<ref name="GF">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Cabbel (Imperial Lieutenant)|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/93283/cid/6569531/2013-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files-Series-2-505-Cabbel}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Lieutenant Cabbel wore the standard-issue [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]] during his service aboard both the ''Avenger''<ref name="Topps" /> and the ''Tyrant''.<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LorthNeedaESB.jpg|thumb|right|150px|In the ''Empire Strikes Back'' novelization, Captain Needa (pictured) and a controller have the roles which are given to Captain Lennox and Lieutenant Cabbel in the film.]]
Cabbel first appeared as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="ESB" /> He was portrayed by [[Oliver Maguire]]<ref name="Maguire autograph">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsautographcollecting.com/Autographs/StarWarsTrilogy/ESB/OliverMaguire.htm|text=Trilogy Autographs|work=Dahoov's Autograph Collecting|archivedate=20040929002343}}</ref> and credited only as one of several "Other [[Officer/Legends|Officers]]."<ref name="ESB" /> Cabbel and Lennox are both absent from the film's [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|novelization]], which instead attributes their scene, with slightly altered dialogue, to Captain Needa and a [[Controller/Legends|controller]] aboard the ''Avenger''.<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> In [[1998]], Cabbel was first named and given a brief backstory on a card for the ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG-Cabbel" />

Cabbel also appeared in the [[2002]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]'', exclusively as a multiplayer bot. He does not appear in the game's story mode.<ref name="Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref> Cabbel and Lennox were both originally intended to be featured in a story for the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', which did not make the final cut. On [[August 8]], 2014, the [[StarWars.com]] article [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]] released that story along with other material cut from the book.<ref name="Warfare Author's Cut" />

[[File:Cabbel_and_Needa.jpg|thumb|left|180px|''2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back'' retconned Cabbel into a character from the ''Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama.]]
In [[2013]], [[Topps]] Collectibles released ''[[2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2]]'', a trading card set with elements from both the [[Original trilogy|original]] and [[Prequel trilogy|prequel trilogies]] of ''[[Star Wars]]'' films. Along with Cabbel receiving his own individual card,<ref name="GF" /> the ''Empire Strikes Back'' Rebel lieutenant [[Cal Alder/Legends|Cal Alder's]] card also erroneously gave Cabbel's character bio instead of one for Alder.<ref name="GF Alder">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Cal Alder (Rebel Lieutenant)|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/93283/cid/6569530/2013-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files-Series-2-504-Cal-Alder}}</ref> In [[2015]], Topps released ''[[2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back]]'', a trading card set based on the [[1983]] [[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|radio dramatization]] of the ''Empire Strikes Back''. In that set, the "Reporting to Needa" card shows the scene in the dramatization, taking place prior to the Battle of Hoth, where a lieutenant and Captain Needa have a conversation aboard the ''Avenger'' regarding the probe droids the Star Destroyer is deploying in search of the Alliance. The lieutenant is illustrated with Cabbel's appearance, thus [[Retroactive continuity|retconning]] Cabbel as the character in the radio drama.<ref name="ESB RD" /><ref name="Topps" />
